settings.invalidChoice: Choose one of the listed values.
cost.title: What costs tokens
cost.budget: These features count against your usage. Output limits below exclude input and context; actual usage varies. Plain-text reports are free of model calls.
settings.help.barGlyph: Choose the progress-bar glyph; appearance only, no model call.
settings.help.enforceGoal: Require a goal before work; adds guidance, not an extra model call.
settings.help.stepReminder: Remind after this many tool calls; smaller values interrupt more often.
settings.help.awayMinutes: Show a return summary after this idle time; shorter values show it sooner.
settings.help.monitor: Suggest progress updates from evidence; off disables background model checks.
settings.help.monitorMinutes: Time between background checks; shorter intervals can use more tokens.
settings.help.autoDone: Complete eligible items after linked PRs merge; enable only if criteria allow it.
settings.help.retention: Keep ended sessions visible for these hours; longer retains more history.
settings.help.contextWarning: Warn at this context percentage; lower values warn earlier, not auto-compact.
settings.help.notifications: Choose off, toast or sound; sound can be distracting, no model call.
settings.help.language: Follow the host or choose a language; bundled catalogs need no translation. Other languages may use Haiku.
cost.monitorHelp: Haiku: at most 1,600 output tokens per changed active-plan check at the chosen interval ({minutes} min); counts against your usage.
cost.translationHelp: Haiku: up to 64 output tokens to identify a language, then up to 7,000 per batch of about 35 messages for missing translations or retranslation; counts against your usage.
cost.reconcileHelp: Check progress starts one turn in the target session’s model per request; context and output vary and count against your usage.
cost.compactHelp: Compact runs the target session’s model to summarize context once per confirmed request; tokens depend on context and count against your usage.
cost.dispatchHelp: Dispatch starts a turn in the orchestrator’s model or a new Agent; task/context determines tokens, which count against your usage.
cost.messageHelp: Sending a message can start one turn in the receiving session’s model; tokens depend on its context and reply and count against your usage.
